title: In the shadow of the volcano: who lives near the world's volcanoes
excerpt: I mapped all 1,215 of the world's Holocene volcanoes and the people around them. At least 147 million people live within 30 km of one, and 76 volcanoes have a million or more neighbours.
seo_description: A map of the world's Holocene volcanoes and the people living within 10, 30 and 100 km of them, by country, by volcano and by last eruption.
header_alt: Title card reading 'In the shadow of the volcano' in black and red on pale paper, beside a Pacific-centred world map with dashed plate boundaries and volcanoes drawn as circles sized by nearby population, largest on Java, Taiwan, the Philippines and in Mexico. Text: at least 147 million people live within 30 km of one of the world's 1,215 Holocene volcanoes.
